hero.label: Your Host
hero.name: Priscilla Beaton
hero.title: Creator & Host
hero.intro: Seven questions carefully crafted. One half question from AI. One conversation you couldn't have planned.

paragraphs.text: Priscilla Beaton is a New York based journalist and the founder of Seven and a Half Questions, a media company devoted to interviews and original storytelling.

Her distinctly New York education began in the twos program at the Barnard College Center for Toddler Development, where she learned an early lesson that stayed with her: when something matters, hold on tighter if you do not want to lose it. As the youngest of four children and the only girl among three brothers, she learned early to speak up, stand her ground, and think independently.

Priscilla went on to attend the Episcopal School in the City of New York, where storytelling was woven through literature, music, rhythm, humor, and stories created by the children themselves. There, her earliest love of narrative began to take shape. That foundation continued through eleven formative years at the Spence School, where a rigorous emphasis on writing sharpened her skills and deepened her interest in the stories people carry with them.

She later attended the Professional Children’s School, which enabled her to move to Los Angeles and intern at MGM Unscripted. The school’s individualized approach and incredible educators encouraged students to follow their passions from a young age. It showed her how the right environment can give ambition room to grow, while leaving space for curiosity, discipline, and imagination.

She earned her undergraduate degree from Barnard College, Columbia University, and later completed her master’s degree at Columbia University’s Graduate School of Journalism. Her professional experience includes journalism, television production, script development, interviewing, and creative strategy.

A lifelong advocate for animals, Priscilla is currently developing a short documentary about Felix, her family’s rescue dog, and his unlikely nighttime playdates with the coyotes of Central Park. After dark, when the city quiets and the park takes on another life, Felix has found companionship in one of New York’s most elusive communities. The project brings together her interest in journalism, animals, and the hidden stories unfolding throughout the city.

Priscilla founded Seven and a Half Questions as a home for thoughtful journalism and conversations that move beyond the expected. She interviews people with compelling stories, distinctive perspectives, and something unexpected to share. Priscilla writes the seven questions herself. The final half question is created by AI, giving each conversation a small turn toward the unknown. Sometimes, half a question can open a door that a whole one leaves closed.

halfQuestion.label: The Half Question
halfQuestion.heading: Why AI writes the last question
halfQuestion.body: At the end of every interview, an AI reads the full transcript and generates a single question, one that could not have been written in advance because it emerges from the specific conversation that just happened. It is entirely out of Priscilla's hands. Unexpected, unpredictable, and entirely its own.
halfQuestion.pullQuote: A question neither of us knew was coming.

connect.label: Get in touch
connect.heading: Stay Connected
connect.body: The best conversations come from unexpected suggestions. If you know someone who should answer the half question, Priscilla wants to hear about it.
